programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: Verano de 1984. Thatcher gobierna y el Sindicato Nacional de Mineros (NUM) ha convocado una huelga. Durante la manifestación del Orgullo Gay en Londres, un grupo de lesbianas y gays se dedica a recaudar fondos para ayudar a las familias de los mineros.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película narra la historia de amistad entre un profesor universitario y Hachi, el perro de Akita. Hachi, símbolo de la lealtad y la amistad, esperará en la estación pacientemente a un dueño que puede que no vuelva nunca.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: Teniente Corrupto
programme.desc: El teniente Terence McDonough, adicto a las drogas por sus dolores crónicos de espalda, investiga el asesinato de cinco inmigrantes senegaleses en Nueva Orleans.

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir. El film obtuvo 3 nominaciones a los Oscar, 2011.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: 3 generaciones
programme.desc: Un adolescente trans quiere iniciar su transición, pero necesita el consentimiento de sus padres mientras su familia aprende a aceptar su identidad.

programme.title: El Cid: La leyenda
programme.desc: La historia de un chico que se convierte en hombre, un hombre que se convierte en héroe y un héroe que finalmente se convierte en leyenda: la leyenda de Rodrigo Vivar, conocido como El Cid.

programme.title: Redada Mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: Batalla Espacial: La Armada Ataca
programme.desc: En 2420, después de que una raza de alienígenas y poderosos magos esclavizaran a gran parte de la humanidad, un grupo de rebeldes organiza un contraataque pilotando una flota de naves espaciales.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios
programme.desc: Barney Ross (Stallone) es un veterano de guerra que ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate. No dudan en matar para conseguir sus objetivos, si bien tienen un lema muy claro: "sólo a quienes lo merezcan".

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: Robot Wasteland
programme.desc: En un mundo postapocalíptico dominado por máquinas rebeldes y bandas de saqueadores, una madre y su hija luchan por proteger la última fuente de agua limpia.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura
programme.desc: Una joven se involucra con un hombre con la idea de que va a hacer una película cuando lo que él pretende es convertirla en vigilante enmascarada.

programme.title: Vuelo 192
programme.desc: Sarah Plummer, agente del FBI, ve cómo su familia es secuestrada durante un vuelo a Washington. Cuando una misteriosa pasajera se sienta a su lado, deberá tomar una decisión que puede costarle la vida de su marido y su hijo.

programme.title: Rescate en Damasco
programme.desc: Adib Abdel Kareem escapó de Siria hace más de 30 años, dejando atrás al amor de su vida, Fátima, para establecerse en Toronto y empezar una nueva vida. Pero ahora debe regresar a su país cuando su hija Muna, que es periodista, desaparece en Damasco.

programme.title: Un tipo de altura
programme.desc: El "largo" Dexter King, tímido y torpe, es el hombro de un comediante que trabaja en Drury Lane. Alérgico a las plumas, Dexter, a quien un médico le ha recetado una serie de inyecciones, conoce a la enfermera Kate y se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Educando a mamá
programme.desc: Grace es una madre soltera que decide casarse con el doctor Hartford para que su hija reciba la atención que necesita. La niña, después de estudiar literatura, empieza a ser más rebelde.

programme.title: Will You Merry Me
programme.desc: After Rebecca and Henry get engaged, they gather their families for the holidays to surprise them with the good news. But will their clashing families ever get along?

programme.title: 3 Holiday Tails
programme.desc: David and Lisa are meant to be together, but they haven't figured that out yet! With help from family, friends, and four lovable dogs, this couple will truly have a Christmas to remember.

programme.title: Nicky Deuce
programme.desc: Nicholas es enviado a vivir con su abuela y su tío a Brooklyn durante el verano, pero tras atender una llamada telefónica el decide emprender una gran transformación personal y se convertirá en Nicky Deuce para llevar a cabo una misteriosa misión.

programme.title: Atrapada en San Valentin
programme.desc: Después de la peor cita de San Valentín de su vida, Katherine vuelve de camino a su casa cuando una gitana le lanza un hechizo. A la mañana siguiente, se dará cuenta de que está reviviendo el mismo día.

programme.title: Papa Moll & The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: El caos se apodera de la casa el único fin de semana que el Señor Moll se queda solo al cuidado de los niños. Mientras él trabaja, los niños comienzan una pelea con los niños del vecino. Una lucha de chocolatinas, tareas para el cole y un Perro Circense.

programme.title: Pettson & Findus
programme.desc: El señor Pettson vive en una pequeña casa, cortando madera, haciendo trabajos peculiares, trabajando en sus inventos, pescando, y cuidando de sus gallinas. Parece que tiene todo en orden hasta que su vecina le da un pequeño gato para que le haga compañía.

programme.title: Mi Amigo Raffi
programme.desc: Sammy, de ocho años, tiene pequeño roedor que no es un hamster cualquiera: no sólo puede jugar al fútbol sino que también puede detectar materiales de contrabando. Un día Raffi desaparece pero nadie tiempo para ayudarle a buscarlo.

programme.title: Storm y la carta prohibida de Lutero
programme.desc: Storm Voeten, hijo del copista Klaas Voeten, se convierte en la diana de una cacería de la Inquisición. Ayudado por Marieke, una misteriosa chica que vive en las cloacas de Antwerp, Storm es capturado en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar a su padre.

programme.title: El general murió al amanecer
programme.desc: En los años 30, en plena guerra civil china, el aventurero O'Hara, indignado por el trato que el general Yang dispensa a sus compatriotas, envía dinero al señor Wu para que compre en Shangai armas.

programme.title: Vuelo 192
programme.desc: Sarah Plummer, agente del FBI, ve cómo su familia es secuestrada durante un vuelo a Washington. Cuando una misteriosa pasajera se sienta a su lado, deberá tomar una decisión que puede costarle la vida de su marido y su hijo.

programme.title: Headhunters
programme.desc: Un reclutador corporativo, quien también se dedica a robar arte, planea robar una pintura valiosa del candidato perfecto para un trabajo vacante.

programme.title: El secreto del lago
programme.desc: Un adolescente descubre un oscuro secreto que desata una peligrosa cadena de acontecimientos.

programme.title: Cuatro vidas
programme.desc: La película se Basa en un proverbio chino según el cual la existencia humana se divide en cuatro emociones: felicidad, placer, pena y amor. Estas emociones acaban cruzándose a través de cuatro personajes.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Hojas de hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: A una adolescente y su familia le suceden fenómenos extraños después de haberse mudado a una casa de campo.

programme.title: Campus Code
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes lucha contra fuerzas desconocidas en su campus para encontrar respuestas.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: Greta, de 12 años, es llevada a través del país por su padre, quien intenta mantener unida a su familia tras la ruptura de su matrimonio.

programme.title: Los Padecientes
programme.desc: Un thriller psicológico que gira en torno a una joven mujer que se enfrenta a oscuros secretos familiares, mientras su salud mental y su percepción de la realidad comienzan a desmoronarse.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Un día, a Tom Avery (Martín Sheen), un reputado oftalmólogo viudo, le comunican que su hijo Daniel, con el que nunca ha tenido buenas relaciones, ha muerto en los Pirineos durante un temporal.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de "Paris, je t'aime" doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como set y narran diferentes historias de amor.

programme.title: Extra-Terrestres
programme.desc: Una familia, 100,000 pollos con una sentencia de muerte, una niña con un secreto que revelará los de su familia, y una estrella a 2,500 años luz que los hará entender que todos estamos, metafóricamente, fuera de este mundo.

programme.title: Hedi
programme.desc: Hedi es un chico sencillo: no habla mucho, no tiene mucho carácter y no espera demasiado de una vida que ya tiene trazada. Indiferente ante todo lo que le rodea, acepta las cosas como se presentan...

programme.desc: Nathalie enseña Filosofía en un instituto de París. Su trabajo le apasiona y disfruta con la reflexión. Un día, su marido le dice que la deja por otra mujer. Con tanta libertad, Nathalie se ve obligada a reinventar su vida.

programme.title: Mi casa en París
programme.desc: Mathias, un desventurado neoyorquino sin esposa, sin hijos y sin un céntimo, hereda de su padre, con quien no se hablaba, una enorme en casa en París, de la que quiere deshacerse lo antes posible.

programme.desc: Desafortunadamente en el amor, Abbey comparte las frustraciones de sus citas con su tía, quien sugiere que escriba una carta de amor explicando los deseos de su verdadero corazón.

programme.title: Me gusta mi cuñada
programme.desc: Sandro es un joven italiano que se traslada con sus padres para pasar el verano en una casa de un pequeño pueblo. Una vez allí, vuelve a ver a sus amigos de todos los veranos, pero también hace nuevas amistades.

programme.title: En tránsito
programme.desc: Segunda Guerra Mundial. En Marsella, refugiados de toda Europa embarcan rumbo a América, huyendo de la ocupación nazi. Entre ellos, el joven alemán Georg, suplanta la identidad de un escritor para utilizar su visado, que le garantiza refugio en México.

programme.title: El amor es extraño
programme.desc: Ben y George aprovechan la nueva ley y deciden casarse. De vuelta de la luna de miel, debido al revuelo mediático que generó su matrimonio, despiden a George de su puesto como director del coro de una escuela católica mixta.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: Señor y Señora Adelman
programme.desc: Contada mediante flashbacks desde principios de los 70 hasta la actualidad, el romance turbulento de una pareja empieza cuando Victor, un escritor angustiado, conoce a Sarah, una estudiante de doctorado brillante que se enamora de él perdidamente.

programme.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programme.desc: Miriam, una mujer que adora a su familia y tiene una agencia de organización de bodas, ayudará a su hija mayor a recuperarse tras una ruptura bastante difícil.

programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, un oficial de corrección novato lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: Moebius
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, un misterioso accidente ocurre en el metro de Buenos Aires: un coche que circulaba por la vía desaparece, perdiéndose en el tiempo debido a un extraño fenómeno que solo un científico puede resolver.

programme.title: Una Familia Genial
programme.desc: Max Smart es el más joven de una familia de inventores. Max siente se siente menos que su hermana mayor y sus padres. Los tres son inteligentes inventores que ganan premios mientras que él nunca ha conseguido ninguno ya que todos sus inventos salen mal.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Air Force One
programme.desc: After making a speech in Moscow vowing to never negotiate with terrorists, President James Marshall boards Air Force One with his family and advisers. When a group of terrorists led by Ivan Korshunov hijacks the flight, the President's principles are put to the test. Feigning escape, ex-soldier Marshall stows away in the aircraft and must race against time to rescue his family and everyone else on board.

programme.title: Resident Evil

There, a deadly virus has been unleashed, killing the lab's personnel and resurrecting them as the evil Undead. The team has just three hours to shut down the lab's supercomputer and close the facility before the virus threatens to overrun the Earth.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson & The Organization
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. In 2019, one of these artists is the legendary bluesman Lucky Peterson, master of the blues guitar and Hammond organ, who celebrates 50 years on stage. Peterson is accompanied by his band The Organization, augmented by the talented vocalist Tamara Tramell. In a singular performance, she offers a fascinating mix of southern soul and modern R&B, exploring the limits of blues and funk.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dionne Warwick
programme.sub-title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick's vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne's magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story. That's how her, along with composer Burt Bacharach and lyricist Hal David become pioneers of the brand of pop music called “Middle of the Road”, meaning pop that is grippingly simple, but never trite. Sixty of her hits made it into the American charts and sold over 100 million albums worldwide. This amazing 1964 recording from the 27 Club in Knokke, Belgium showcases the 23-year-old star vocalist at the start of her career.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák's spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Evanescence
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. In late 2017, Evanescence re-emerged from their hiatus with Synthesis—a reimagining of their best-known songs with orchestra & electronics and an accompanying sold-out and highly-acclaimed world tour. On November 3, 2017 Evanescence performed “Synthesis Live” in front of a sold out crowd at the Grand Theater at Foxwoods Casino in CT.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: One Night In Miami…
programme.desc: This powerful film is a fictional account of one incredible night where American icons Muhammad Ali (Eli Goree), Malcolm X (Kingsley Ben-Adir), Sam Cooke (Leslie Odom Jr.), and Jim Brown (Aldis Hodge) gathered, discussing their roles in the civil rights movement and cultural upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: An up-and-coming district attorney takes on the case of a young woman who has accused three men of sexual assault. She puts her career on the line in order to uncover a deeper web of mystery, murder and deception.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Based on the true story of one of Miami's most notorious businessmen and gangster's, SPEED KILLS is a high-octane thriller, described as “The Wolf of Wall Street on Water.”

programme.title: Coming home in the dark
programme.desc: A family's outing descends into terror when teacher Alan Hoaganraad, his wife Jill and stepsons Maika and Jordon explore an isolated coastline. An unexpected meeting with a pair of drifters thrusts the family into a nightmare when they find themselves captured.

programme.title: The Jungle
programme.desc: An Indonesian forest demon stalks the members of an expedition group on a mission to locate and tag the mythical Javan Leopard deep in the rain-forest. Contains bad language and violence.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Before the 2008 financial meltdown, a team of investors placed bets against the US mortgage market. As they dug deeper, they were shocked by the levels of corruption they found. Contains strong language and sexual content.

programme.title: The Professor
programme.desc: Johnny Depp plays Richard, a buttoned-down college lecturer, whose life is turned upside down after learning he has six months to live. To the shock of his wife (Rosemarie DeWitt: La La Land) and school chancellor (Ron Livingston: The Conjuring) and the delight of his students - Richard embarks on a hilarious crusade against authority, with sex, drugs and bad behaviour in this dark comedy.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: A fading comedian and a suicidally despondent ballet dancer must look to each other to find purpose and hope in their lives. Contains mature themes.

programme.title: Fast Food Nation
programme.desc: The hit mockumentary taking a deep dive into the health issues and social consequences of America's love affair with fast food. From Academy Award nominated director, Richard Linklater, this darkly comedic satire is packed with A-list cameos from the likes of Patricia Arquette, Ethan Hawke, Bobby Cannavale, Paul Dano, Bruce Willis, Kris Kristofferson and Avril Lavigne.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: When an international team of former Cold War intelligence adversaries meet in a Warehouse, their venture of friendship, intrigue and betrayal has just begun.

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: A humble businessman with a buried past seeks justice when his daughter is killed in an act of terrorism.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: A man decides to take justice into his own hands after a plea bargain sets one of his family's killers free.

programme.title: Patriots Day
programme.desc: Chronicles the courage and power of the people of Boston during the manhunt for the Boston Marathon bombers.

programme.title: Hunter Killer
programme.desc: Navy SEALs try to stop a renegade Russian military leader who wants to start a war.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: The Monster
programme.desc: A mother and daughter must confront a terrifying monster when they break down on a deserted road.

programme.title: Bad Match
programme.desc: Totally app-licable in the modern era of dating, this gripping, psychological thriller will have you thinking twice about your next swipe. It's all fun and games for Playboy Harris - he has it sussed when it comes to hooking up with new women. Little does he know, that his match with the obsessively twisted Riley is about to send his life into complete disarray. One to watch!

programme.title: The Siren
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents - a seductive, heart-wrenching story of passion and revenge of cursed star-crossed lovers, who will never let go. Tom rents a cabin on a secluded lake, marked by a local legend of a lovelorn spirit. He knows he has found his soulmate in the seemingly human Nina, who must repress her demonic instincts. Meanwhile, a man hunts the monster who killed his husband.

programme.title: Slumber
programme.desc: Maggie Q (Designated Survivor) stars in this mind-bending, sleep-paralysis horror. Sleep doctor Alice abandons all rational scientific reasoning while investigating a peculiar family case - a legendary demon that feeds on its victims by paralysing them in their sleep. To help this family from their nightmare, she must confront her own childhood demons to defeat this dark spirit. Truly eye-opening!

programme.title: All About Sex
programme.desc: Join Morgan, Casey and Sage in the sizzling, provocative and hilarious All About Sex. Three friends in their mid-20s navigate their professional and personal lives in the big city as they collide head on with the messy, hilarious and sometimes dreadful growing pains of adulthood. Written and directed by, as well as starring Dakota Gorman (Teen Wolf), All About Sex also stars Natalee Linez (Siren).

programme.title: Dark Crimes
programme.desc: From the executive producers of The Revenant, Jim Carrey commands the screen in this spellbinding thriller. When a disgraced detective Tadek notices the stark similarities between a murder case and a crime novel written by Kozlow (Marton Csokas), he sees an opportunity to redeem his career. Digging deeper Tadek is soon caught up in a game of cat and mouse, that will reveal a dark truth! Gripping!

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: A twisted mystery based on the acclaimed novel by Shirley Jackson ('The Haunting of Hill House'). Merricat (Taissa Farmiga - 'The Nun') lives with her sister Constance (Alexandra Daddario - 'Baywatch') and her Uncle Julian (Crispin Glover - 'Back to the Future').

programme.title: When We Get There
programme.desc: Two brothers set out on a 2,000-mile road trip to find their father, confronting uncertain futures, fragile relationships and the meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Sweetland
programme.desc: Sweetland is the story of an isolated community at the outermost edge of the world, and the struggles of one man determined to resist its extinction.

programme.title: Gangland Revenge
programme.desc: After his son is killed in a gang hit, a father must protect his broken family and seek justice. Drawing on his past as a fighter, he enters the brutal gangland underworld to take down his son's killers. Gangland Revenge is a tense British crime thriller.

programme.title: Love Always Santa
programme.desc: A struggling writer finds inspiration, and possibly romance, when he finds a letter to Santa from a woman asking for her lonely mother to find love again. Stars Marguerite Moreau, Mike Faiola (2016)

programme.title: Christmas at Holly Lodge
programme.desc: Sophie is the proud owner of the perfect Christmas getaway destination. Will her blossoming relationship with a guest end when she discovers his ulterior motive for staying at Holly Lodge? (2017)

programme.title: Candy Cane Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Christmas romance with Beverley Mitchell. When her favourite tradition of decorating Candy Cane Lane is cancelled, can Phoebe find something - or someone - new to lift her Christmas spirits?

programme.title: Holiday Wish Come True
programme.desc: Two sisters' only wish is to spend the holidays as a family, forcing their divorced parents to work out their issues and find love again. Starring Schuyler Fisk (2018)

programme.title: Becks
programme.desc: A musical drama following a singer who rediscovers herself after a break up. Starring Tony Award Winning Lena Hall.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.

programme.title: Blind
programme.desc: Bestselling novelist, Bill Oakland loses his wife and his sight in a vicious car crash. Five years later Socialite Suzanne Dutchman is forced to read to Bill in an intimate room three times a week as a plea bargain for being associated with her husband's insider trading.

programme.title: Comet
programme.desc: Comet explores the six-year relationship between Dell and Kimberly, as it skips around between five pivotal moments.

programme.title: Finding Mrs. Claus
programme.desc: When Mrs. Claus (Mira Sorvino) feels neglected by her less than attentive husband (Will Sasso), she goes to Las Vegas to help a little girl with her Christmas wish.

programme.title: Holiday Road Trip
programme.desc: Two feuding business associates fall for each other while escorting a celebrity dog on a Christmas promotional tour.

programme.title: Fixing Up Christmas
programme.desc: Known as a “fixer” for difficult clients, a talented party planner must help a young CEO plan the Christmas party of the year to dazzle the mayor and save his company. Wil the "fixer" fix something more than just the company?

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa's Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

programme.title: Belles Christmas Gift
programme.desc: Alesha hates Christmas so she reluctantly agrees to visit her Caribbean grandmother to help organize her annual Christmas charity function to save her clinic. When she arrives with her best friend, Alesha meets a handsome Brit, Garrett Graham.

programme.title: Belle and the Beast
programme.desc: Eric Landry is a cold-hearted man that people have nicknamed "the Beast." Years of anger and bitterness have consumed him, turning him into a selfish man. But Belle Watson is the exact opposite. When her father accidentally breaks a valuable work of art at the Landry mansion, Belles agrees to work for Eric in an effort to repay him and save her father's job. She discovers there just might be more to Eric. Will she find the man within the Beast?

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God's protection and Derek's assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek's own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Mary 4 Mayor
programme.desc: Running for mayor against her incumbent mayor father, an eighteen-year-old young woman learns valuable life lessons that not only are the building blocks to saving her family, but also the town she lives in.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: An aspiring writer, Jo leaves for New York determined to publish a novel, but her editor challenges her to write about something more interesting—her family.

programme.title: Psycho BFF
programme.desc: Renee forbids her daughter's relationship with a friend from continuing.

programme.title: Dark Influences
programme.desc: First-hand accounts of people who were manipulated, abused and finally broke free.

programme.title: I Won't Let You Go
programme.desc: Angela can't seem to shake the stalker who is ruining her life.

programme.title: The Rival
programme.desc: Alice loses baby in robbery marries George Miller. Stars Tracy Nelson.

programme.title: Psycho BFF
programme.desc: Renee forbids her daughter's relationship with a friend from continuing.

programme.title: Amber's Story
programme.desc: This is the true story of the kidnapping of Amber Hagerman and how her family came together to help other abducted children as a result of her tragedy which resulted in a new system to help find missing children - The Amber Alert.

programme.title: Ring of Deception
programme.desc: When Julie falls for the charms of her new neighbor, another woman is determined to kill them both.

programme.title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
programme.desc: At the Gamma Christmas Mixer, Sarah is missing and her friends' search leads to a shocking attack.

programme.title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
programme.desc: Most leave for break, while a few stay behind. Rick is pushed to his breaking point and flips out on Allison.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Sparks fly between an interior designer and a handsome pilot who finds homes for rescue dogs.

programme.title: I Think I Do
programme.desc: The relationship between three sisters, as one is left at the altar on her wedding day.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.desc: For John Clasky (Adam Sandler), life as a celebrity chef means balancing a high-profile career and raising a family. So when his family hires a gorgeous new housekeeper from Mexico, John quickly learns it may be his life that needs translation!

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding (1997)
programme.desc: Two friends (Julia Roberts and Dermot Mulroney) go from an impossible possibility to an unimaginable reality in this romantic comedy.

programme.title: Another You
programme.desc: ANOTHER YOU is the uproarious slapstick comedy about a pathological liar who, upon his release from a mental clinic, becomes involved with a con man and ends up impersonating a billionaire. Scam follows double-scam in classic Pryor/Wilder style. Features Academy Award winner Mercedes Ruehl as a con who falls for Gene Wilder.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Nicole Kidman and wickedly funny Will Ferrell star as actors playing Darrin and Samantha on a remake of the television show "Bewitched" in this cleverly crafty comedy from director NoraEphron.

programme.title: California King
programme.desc: When mattress store manager Perry's childhood crush Lynette announces she's leaving town, he panics. Desperate to prove himself, he and his reckless best friend Wyatt concoct a harebrained scheme to "rescue" her younger brother from a fake kidnapping—only to accidentally pull off a real one.

programme.title: War, Inc.
programme.desc: In this political satire, a heartless CEO hires a troubled hit man to kill a Middle East oil minister and capitalize on the aftermath. Featuring an ensemble cast including John Cusack, Hilary Duff, Marisa Tomei, Joan Cusack, Dan Aykroyd and more.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: An action comedy in the vein of MIDNIGHT RUN about an ex-FBI agent (Jones) and an ex-mob lawyer in the witness protection program (Freeman) having to put aside their petty rivalry on the golf course to fend off a mob hit.

programme.title: I'm Still Here
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Casey Affleck takes a turn behind the camera to document a tumultuous year in the life of fellow Oscar-winning actor, Joaquin Phoenix, as he announces his retirement from a successful film career and sets off to reinvent himself as a hip-hop musician.

programme.title: Mackenzie's Raiders EP29-32
programme.desc: Colonel Mackenzie, commander of the 4th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Clark near Brackettville in Kinney County in southwest Texas during the 1870s, receives secret orders from President Ulysses S. Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.title: Damned Pistols of Dallas
programme.desc: Outlaw Fast Draw (Álvarez) assaults stagecoach with passengers Clay Stone (Beir), singer Katy Dior (Marandi) and gambler Fred Foster (Mathot), but Stone is ready to take revenge.

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: A bounty hunter named Amen is hired by a group of nuns to recover stolen money. However, the nuns turn out to be female desperadoes in disguise, plotting to retrieve the booty pillaged by the ruthless outlaw Catapult and his gang. Amen must navigate a world of deception, danger, and betrayal to complete the job.

programme.title: The Divorce of Lady X
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier plays Logan, a divorce lawyer, stranded in overcrowded hotel.

programme.title: Passport to Shame
programme.desc: When Malou arrives in England, it seems that she is condemned to a miserable life.

programme.title: Plague of the zombies
programme.desc: The local squire in a Cornish village is using the voodoo magic to unleash the undead on the population.

programme.title: Some Girls Do
programme.desc: Comedy spy film starring Richard Johnson and Daliah Lavi.

programme.title: Ship That Died of Shame
programme.desc: Based on a short story by Nicholas Monsarrat and directed by Basil Dearden.

programme.title: Hunting with the Enemy
programme.desc: An urn commissioned in a Cambodian monastery by the Chinese emperor for the remains of Confucius is about to be destroyed by systematic bombing of a whole province.

programme.title: Under the Ice
programme.desc: Despite terrible weather, Sidney drags Nigel along to an Arctic base where an ancient Indian mummy has been found, who turns out to be an Anasazi.

programme.title: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to Istanbul to investigate the death of one Sydney's friends, a professor who was trying to prove Hercules did exist by finding the Belt of Hippolyte.

programme.title: Faux Fox
programme.desc: When Nigel is charmed by brilliant student Lorraine to show her their offices (and kiss), a burglar knocks out Sidney, but what was robbed?

programme.title: Pandoras Box
programme.desc: Sidney inherits from the best relic hunter of the previous generation a key and rushes with Nigel on the hunt for the one treasure he never found: Pandora's box.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Bekkastan, 1401 AD: warrior princess Kahina proves her right to rule. 2002: Sydney and Nigel unearth a cave painting that might lead them to Kahina's Saddle. But her descendants cause complications.

programme.title: Fountain of Youth
programme.desc: While Nigel rehearses his keynote speech in a Seville hotel room, a girl nearly breaks his nose demanding something - it turns out she was after the water from the Fountain of Youth.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: Nick Wild (Jason Statham) is a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal professional skills and a personal gambling problem. When a friend is beaten by a sadistic thug, Nick strikes back, only to find out the thug is the son of a powerful mob boss.

programme.desc: After a failed mission to capture the leader of a deadly gambling ring, bounty hunter Will Tanner becomes the hunted—a human target in a game in which contestants must kill or be killed.

programme.desc: When the body of a gang member is discovered in the freezer of crime boss Alphonse's (Terrence Howard) mansion - a clear message has been sent… or has it?

programme.title: Avalanche (1999)
programme.desc: The survivor of an Alaskan avalanche, Dr. Lia Freeman (Caroleen Feeney) is an environmentalist concerned about a similar disaster occurring if a proposed new oil pipeline is built. Freeman adamantly warns the planners of the likelihood of a major avalanche, but they ignore her pleas. As she realizes that a massive whiteout is imminent, Freeman tries to get the citizens of a nearby town to leave, aided by brave helicopter pilot Neal Meekin (Thomas Ian Griffith).

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Dillinger And Capone [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist.

programme.title: A Dark Place
programme.desc: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

programme.title: Comment séduire un prince
programme.desc: À New York, une conseillère en rencontres amoureuses tente de séduire un prince qu'elle accompagne dans le milieu des rendez-vous galants.

programme.title: Un amour d'animateur
programme.desc: Savannah est engagée pour redorer le blason d'un animateur de radio à New York. Elle se retrouve accidentellement à l'antenne avec celui-ci.

programme.title: Amour au glaçage royal
programme.desc: Emma, pâtissière à New York, est engagée pour la fête d'anniversaire du roi et de la reine de Sanovia.

programme.title: Amour, set et match
programme.desc: Liz, une enseignante au secondaire, met ses élèves au défi de créer des plans d'affaires : ils lancent une application de rencontre.

programme.title: Mickey One
programme.desc: A comic with gambling debts runs away to Chicago, and under an assumed name, takes a job as a janitor.

programme.title: Berserk!
programme.desc: The owner of a small traveling circus is under suspicion when the circus becomes plagued by a spate of murders

programme.title: The Daring Young Man
programme.desc: An army reject inadvertently stumbles into the middle of a Nazi spy ring.

programme.title: Under The Yum Yum Tree
programme.desc: A couple in love agree to determine their "character compatability" by living together platonically.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Jeff Lowe's Metanoia

programme.title: Lucky Peterson & The Organization
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. In 2019, one of these artists is the legendary bluesman Lucky Peterson, master of the blues guitar and Hammond organ, who celebrates 50 years on stage. Peterson is accompanied by his band The Organization, augmented by the talented vocalist Tamara Tramell. In a singular performance, she offers a fascinating mix of southern soul and modern R&B, exploring the limits of blues and funk.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dionne Warwick
programme.sub-title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick's vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne's magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story. That's how her, along with composer Burt Bacharach and lyricist Hal David become pioneers of the brand of pop music called “Middle of the Road”, meaning pop that is grippingly simple, but never trite. Sixty of her hits made it into the American charts and sold over 100 million albums worldwide. This amazing 1964 recording from the 27 Club in Knokke, Belgium showcases the 23-year-old star vocalist at the start of her career.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák's spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Evanescence
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. In late 2017, Evanescence re-emerged from their hiatus with Synthesis—a reimagining of their best-known songs with orchestra & electronics and an accompanying sold-out and highly-acclaimed world tour. On November 3, 2017 Evanescence performed “Synthesis Live” in front of a sold out crowd at the Grand Theater at Foxwoods Casino in CT.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

En busca de fortuna, la pareja se une para seducir y quitar el dinero a los hombres que caen en su trampa. Max se encarga de buscar hombres ricos, que tras ser conquistados harán todo por ella.

programme.title: The Animal (2001)
programme.desc: Puede que no parezca mucho, pero lo que cuenta está dentro. El genio de la comedia Rob Schneider (Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, Big Daddy), Colleen Haskell del concurso de televisión Survivor, John C. McGinley (Any Given Sunday, The Rock) y Edward Asner (The Bachelor, JFK) aparecen en la comedia más escandalosa e histérica del año. Cuando el guardia de seguridad Marvin Mange (Schneider) responde a una llamada de emergencia sobre un robo en progreso, su sueño de convertirse en policía podría convertirse en realidad. Pero un extraño accidente de tráfico en su camino al lugar del crimen deja a Martin y a su sueño destrozados. Cuando Marvin se despierta una semana después, descubre que un científico desquiciado secretamente ha usado órganos de animales para reconstruir su cuerpo. Con nuevas energías gracias a sus nuevas y mejoradas partes, Marvin consigue fama al instante como superpolicía hasta que su instinto animal empieza a apoderarse de su cuerpo en los peores momentos. Y cuando se enamora de la encantadora y sexy Rianna (Haskell), ¡es magnetismo animal en su máxima expresión en la comedia más divertida y salvaje del año! No te pierdas a Rob Schneider en Big Daddy.

programme.title: No Me Mientas Que Te Creo

Todo sale según sus planes hasta que un ladrón (Benicio del Toro) roba el coche en cuyo maletero está escondida.

programme.title: El grito en la sangre
